files.file: removed maxlength from #description; added #description-count counter and aria-live wrapper holding hidden #description-limit message

added attachLimit helper (code-point count, message, aria-invalid/describedby, Save disabled); wired to create and edit forms; submit guards; refresh after reset and after clearBusy; edit textarea maxlength removed
added .char-count, .over-limit, .limit-status, .limit-message and edit-form layout rules using existing theme variables

tests.test: Backend pytest run (result in notes); node --check app.js ok. No browser check was done.

design_decisions.decision: One shared attachLimit helper for both forms; rejected duplicating logic per form.
refresh() runs explicitly after form.reset() and after clearBusy; rejected a reset event listener (explicit is simpler and ordering-safe).
Save disabled = over OR aria-busy, so loading is never cleared by the limit logic; rejected plain disabled=over.
Live-region wrapper is static in DOM; inner message is hidden when empty so under-limit typing announces nothing.
Colors reuse --muted and --danger (counter/message sit on page bg), no new variables.

implementation.self_critique: Not browser-verified: 360px layout, negative margin on edit-form counter, and contrast computed only by reasoning from existing palette. Least covered: criteria 14 and 15.
